questions.subject: biology
questions.problem_type: 用补加化合物救援模式检验B底物产物关系
questions.search_text:
*E. coli* can normally grow on minimal media.You expose some *E. coli* to UV light which
creates a single point mutation in each bacterium.You dilute the *E. coli* and grow it on full
media so all colonies can grow.You 'stamp' replica plates onto plates containing minimal
media, or minimal media containing supplements *i-iv*. Only some colonies can grow on
each plate.

This type of genetic analysis can be used to dissect the steps in a biosynthesis pathway. For
example, here it can be seen that the gene product (enzyme) lost in colony A is involved in
the synthesis of compound *i*, and all compounds *ii-iv* are made from *i*.

Sketch a pathway for the synthesis of compounds *i-iv*. Label the steps with enzymes *A-D*.
*Note, the pathway may have branches.*Are the following true or false?
Mark the following as TRUE or FALSE

*B* synthesises *ii* from *i*.
TRUE
FALSE

questions.problem_type: 原题意为从α/β亚基Western大小比较基因长；实际条带图未在源内
questions.search_text:
A similar experiment identified that *E. coli* mutants *x*, *Y* and *z* have one mutation in
the α or β subunits of tryptophan synthase.You carry out a western blot to visualise
tryptophan synthase in these mutants, and wildtype (WT; not mutated) *E. coli*.

Mark the following as TRUE or FALSE

Unmutated tryptophan synthase α is a longer gene than unmutated tryptophan synthase
β.
TRUE
FALSE

questions.problem_type: 按截短、缺失或正常大小的可能模式区分突变类型；所需WT/X条带源缺失
questions.search_text:
A similar experiment identified that *E. coli* mutants *x*, *Y* and *z* have one mutation in
the α or β subunits of tryptophan synthase.You carry out a western blot to visualise
tryptophan synthase in these mutants, and wildtype (WT; not mutated) *E. coli*.

Check all the types of mutation which *X* could likely have according to these data.
Choose as many as appropriate
a) Frameshift (deletion or insertion of one base)
b) Nonsense (creation of Stop codon)
c) Missense (swapping one amino acid for another)
d) Mutation in regulatory region (e.g. promoter)
e) No mutation
